mapper.select: SELECT c.TOPIC_ID, c.DB_SCHEMA, c.DB_TABLE_NAME, COALESCE(c.POLLING_INTERVAL_MS, 1000) AS POLLING_INTERVAL_MS, t.GROUP_ID FROM TB_CARAVAN_HUB_CONFIG c INNER JOIN TB_CARAVAN_TOPICS t ON c.TOPIC_ID = t.TOPIC_ID WHERE c.INTEGRATION_TYPE = 'DB' AND c.DIRECTION = 'INBOUND' AND c.USE_YN = 'Y' AND t.USE_TP = 'Y'

SELECT c.TOPIC_ID, c.FILE_PATH, c.BACKUP_PATH, c.FTP_HOST, c.FTP_PORT, c.FTP_USER, c.FTP_PASSWORD, COALESCE(c.POLLING_INTERVAL_MS, 1000) AS POLLING_INTERVAL_MS, t.GROUP_ID FROM TB_CARAVAN_HUB_CONFIG c INNER JOIN TB_CARAVAN_TOPICS t ON c.TOPIC_ID = t.TOPIC_ID WHERE c.INTEGRATION_TYPE = 'FILE' AND c.DIRECTION = 'INBOUND' AND c.USE_YN = 'Y' AND t.USE_TP = 'Y'

SELECT TOPIC_ID, DIRECTION, INTEGRATION_TYPE, DB_TABLE_NAME, DB_SCHEMA, HTTP_URL, HTTP_METHOD, HTTP_HEADERS, FILE_PATH, BACKUP_PATH, FTP_HOST, FTP_PORT, FTP_USER, FTP_PASSWORD FROM TB_CARAVAN_HUB_CONFIG WHERE TOPIC_ID = #{TOPIC_ID} AND DIRECTION = 'OUTBOUND' AND USE_YN = 'Y'
